subject.title: Feishu: read image tool result loses media before final outbound payload

question: Which open read-image media fix should own this issue before it can close?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but open candidate PRs choose different trust-boundary shapes and one related security report affects how local media promotion should be accepted.

options.title: Review and repair the shared bridge PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 or a narrow successor as the primary fix if it gets lint, proof, and trust-boundary review.

options.title: Revive the start-args fallback PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50359 if maintainers prefer preserving the original file path instead of persisting inline image bytes.

options.title: Pause for Feishu-specific proof first
options.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer proves whether the direct Feishu `MEDIA:` and message-tool reports are separate defects.

recommendation.title: Review and repair the shared bridge PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 or a narrow successor as the primary fix if it gets lint, proof, and trust-boundary review.

likelyOwner.reason: Most connected to the shared agent media delivery path and recent current-main history for the affected files.
